rationale: The current Premier aggregate names Triage and Response and sets Cloud Platform 10.2.x+ and ES 8.6+ with paired SOAR. The versioned 8.8 task retains the Cloud ES 8.7+ floor, an enabled assistant and connector permission inheritance. It requires existing findings with at least one triage result, a first-ten per-detection burst limit, about 200 findings per tenant per day, frontier models and the granular asset role. The earlier 8.7 task names AI SOC Analyst and has its own Cloud-only history. Current CMP task and indexed setup name Platform 10.4.x+, ES 8.8+, Cloud Connect 2.0+ and SAIA 2.4+. Current SAIA 2.3.6 Cloud Connected exclusions and the 2.1.1 workaround without Agent Mode leave the planned 2.4.0 path unconfirmed. ES 8.8 GA on November 4 and the separate editions/region tables establish no exact pairing, per-agent rollout, component entitlement or customer authorization.
